description_excerpt: Role Purpose: The Product Specialist is responsible for managing the new product development (NPD) launches and product changes across the portfolio in Vietnam. Working to the priorities and direction set by the Space teams (who lead insights, product innovation, portfolio management and pricing), the role coordinates launch delivery, tracks project status, manages platform workflows, and leads Vietnamese label development, including proof checking and sign-off, to ensure accurate, compliant, and on-time launches.
